name: SSH Server Operations
description: Run commands only on a server that is already configured, using its alias, and stop cleanly when no server exists.

permissionsRequired.reason: Run a command on a configured server alias. Host and command are both required.
Confirm .orvyn/ssh.json exists. Do not repeat key paths or secrets from it.

validation.rule: ssh_exec was called with a non-empty configured server alias, or the run stopped because no server resource was configured. No hostname, user, password, or key was invented.
